about.label: About me
about.text:
I'm a Telecommunications Engineer (IFSC) and have spent the last ~2 years as a software developer at Intelbras. Day to day, I build applications for IP telephony products — phones and PABXs — mainly working with Go, React, C, and Lua, alongside embedded Linux based on OpenWrt and the Yocto Project.

My background spans both a technician and an engineering degree in telecommunications, giving me a solid foundation in networking, communication protocols, and embedded systems — knowledge I apply directly to building VoIP software.
